original: The valley lies at the foot of the Wazespitze (3,533 metres) - the highest mountain in the Kaunergrat - and offers exciting mountain tours as well as climbing routes of all levels of difficulty.
translated: Das Tal liegt am Fuße der Wazespitze (3.533 Meter) - dem höchsten Berg des Kaunergrats - und bietet spannende Bergtouren sowie Kletterrouten aller Schwierigkeitsgrade.
